verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is GPU accelerator hardware sold as a DGX/HGX server platform. A built-in AI assistant that users delegate tasks to is not a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such an assistant: the llms.txt files are documentation for external AI agents, and DGX OS and BMC are system and management software, not an embedded assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
